build: wllama scripts/docker-compose.yml steps run with docker run (emscripten/emsdk:4.0.20-arm64, image sha256:db0f491cb72e01f66be890c83f1b2705926b59998c2208e6b44f65d7f0cbcb47, DGX 2026-10-26, rebuilt after the upstream merge): main build -DGGML_WEBGPU=ON -DGGML_WEBGPU_JSPI=ON; compat -DWLLAMA_COMPAT=ON -DLLAMA_WASM_MEM64=OFF -DGGML_WEBGPU=ON -DGGML_WEBGPU_JSPI=OFF; then npm run build:worker, tsup (esm), build:typedef, scripts/post_build.sh. Only esm/index.js, type declarations and wasm are vendored.
measured: 2026-10-26 after the merge: headless Chromium, LFM2.5-350M f16 base + two LoRA GGUFs, CPU, 13.1 s, all 7 checks pass with greedy outputs identical to the 3.6.1-based build: every adapter changes the output, base after an adapter (explicit zero scales and no lora field) equals the base exactly, each stack reproducible after others. Compat build not exercised by the smoke (Chromium uses the main build).
